verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Radar exposes a REST API (e.g., POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve), but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path probed returned 404. The llms.txt file and Markdown API reference pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
